items.text: Abantwana bakwaRubeni nabantwana bakwaGadi babenezinkomo eziningi kakhulu; lapho bebona izwe laseJazeri nezwe lakwaGileyadi, indawo leyo yayiyindawo yezinkomo;
Abantwana bakwaGadi nabantwana bakwaRubeni bafika bakhuluma kuMose naku-Eleyazare umpristi nakubaholi benhlangano bathi:
i-Ataroti, neDiboni, neJazeri, neNimra, neHeshiboni, ne-Elale, neSebam, neNebo, neBeyoni;
Izwe iNkosi eyalinqoba phambi kwebandla lika-Israyeli liyizwe lezinkomo, nezinceku zakho zinemfuyo.
Ngakho bathi: Uba sifumene umusa emehlweni akho, kaliphiwe inceku zakho lelilizwe libe yilifa, ungasiweli iJordani.
Wayesethi uMose kubantwana bakwaGadi nakubantwana bakwaRubeni: “Abafowenu bayakuya empini, nihlale lapha na?”
Nizidumaza ngani izinhliziyo zabantwana bakwa-Israyeli ukuba bawele ezweni uJehova abanike lona na?
Yilokho oyihlo abakwenzayo lapho ngibathuma besuka eKadeshi-Barineya ukuba babone izwe.
Ngokuba lapho bekhuphukela esigodini sase-Eshikoli, balibona izwe, badumaza izinhliziyo zabantwana bakwa-Israyeli ukuba bangangeni ezweni uJehova abanika lona.
Intukuthelo kaJehova yavutha ngaso leso sikhathi, wafunga wathi:
Ngempela, amadoda akhuphuka eGibhithe, kusukela kwabaneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu, ngeke alibone izwe engalifunga ku-Abrahama, no-Isaka, noJakobe; ngoba abangilandelanga ngokuphelele.
Ngaphandle kukaKalebi, indodana kaJefune, umKhenezi, noJoshuwa indodana kaNuni, ngokuba baphikelela eNkosini.
Intukuthelo kaJehova yamvuthela u-Israyeli, wabazulazula ehlane iminyaka engamashumi amane, saze sabhubha sonke isizukulwane esasenza okubi emehlweni kaJehova.
Bhekani, senivukile esikhundleni sawoyihlo, isixuku sabantu abayizoni, ukwandisa ulaka lweNkosi phezu kuka-Israyeli.
Ngokuba uma nimfulathela, uyakubuye abashiye ehlane; futhi uzobhubhisa sonke lesi sizwe.
Base besondela kuye, bathi: “Sizakwakhela izinkomo zethu izibaya lapha, nemizi yabantwana bethu.”
Kepha thina siyakuphuma sihlomile phambi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli size sibafikise endaweni yabo; nabantwana bethu abancane bayohlala emizini enezivikelo eziqinile ngenxa yabakhileyo ezweni.
Asiyikubuyela ezindlini zethu abantwana bakwa-Israyeli baze badle ifa labo, kube yilowo nalowo.
Ngoba ngeke senze amatulo phesheya kweJordani noma ngaphambili; ngoba ifa lethu lisempumalanga yeJordani.
UMose wathi kubo: “Uma nithanda ukwenza lokho, uma niphuma nihlomile phambi kukaJehova ukulwa impi,
Niyakuwela iJordani nonke nihlomile phambi kukaJehova, ize ixoshe izitha zayo phambi kwayo;
Izwe liyakunqotshwa phambi kobuso bukaJehova; leli zwe liyakuba yifa lenu phambi kukaJehova.
Kepha uma ningakwenzi lokhu, bhekani, nonile kuJehova; futhi uqiniseke ukuthi isono sakho siyakuthola.
Zakheleni imizi yabantwana benu nezibaya zezimvu zenu; wenze okuphuma emlonyeni wakho.
Abantwana bakwaGadi nabantwana bakwaRubeni bakhuluma kuMose, bathi: “Izinceku zakho ziyakwenza njengokuyala kwenkosi yami.”
Abantwana bethu, labesifazana bethu, lemihlambi yethu lemfuyo yethu yonke kuzakuba lapho emadolobheni akoGileyadi.
Kodwa izinceku zakho zizawela, bonke abahlomele impi, phambi kweNkosi ukuyakulwa, njengokutsho kwenkosi yami.
UMose wayala ngabo kumpristi u-Eleyazare noJoshuwa indodana kaNuni nezinhloko zezindlu zoyise zezizwe zabantwana bakwa-Israyeli.

UMozisi wasesithi kubo: Uba abantwana bakoGadi labantwana bakoRubeni bechapha iJordani lani, bonke abahlomela ukulwa bazanqotshwa phambi kwe Nkosi lelizwe phambi kwenu; khona-ke kumelwe nibanike izwe lakwaGileyadi njengefa.
Kodwa uma bengaweli nani behlomile, bayakuba nefa phakathi kwenu ezweni laseKhanani.
Abantwana bakoGadi labantwana bakoRubeni basebephendula bathi: Njengoba iN kosi itshilo ezincekwini zakho, sizakwenza njalo.
Sizachapha sihlomile phambi kwe Nkosi, siye elizweni leKhanani, ukuze ifa lethu elisempumalanga kweJordani libe ngelethu.

UMose wabanika abantwana bakwaGadi, nabantwana bakwaRubeni, nenxenye yesizwe sakwaManase, indodana kaJosefa, umbuso kaSihoni, inkosi yama-Amori, nombuso ka-Ogi, inkosi yaseBashani, izwe nemizi yalo emikhawulweni, imizi yezwe nxazonke.
Abantwana bakwaGadi bakha iDiboni, ne-Atharoti, ne-Aroweri;
ne-Atroti, noShofani, noJazeri, noJogibeha,
neBeti-mra neBeti Harani, imizi ebiyelweyo nezibaya zezimvu.
Abantwana bakwaRubeni bakha iHeshiboni, ne-Elale, neKiriyatayimi;
neNebo, neBali Mehoni, lapho amagama aguqukayo, neSibima; bayiqamba amanye amagama imizi abayakhayo.
Abantwana bakwaMagiri indodana kaManase baya kwaGileyadi, balithatha, bawaxosha ama-Amori ayekulo.
UMose walinika uMagire indodana kaManase iGileyadi; wahlala kulo.
UJayire indodana kaManase wahamba wathatha imizana yakhe, wayibiza ngokuthi iHavoti-Jayire.
UNoba wahamba wathatha iKenati nemizana yalo, walibiza ngokuthi iNoba ngegama lakhe.
